_about: The Story view. kitchens: one line per gallery item id (what changed since the last pick); a pick with no line shows its caption. eclairs: the eclair strand in order; each sits under its anchor kitchen (an items.json id), or under the next picked kitchen after it. New rounds: add a line here when Ari picks the round's kitchen.

kitchens.app-kitchen-noon: The kitchen as first built in the app (#84): a plain wall, a shelf, a cork board and a cardboard recipe box. You found it drab, and that started the redesign.
kitchens.app-kitchen-night: The kitchen as first built in the app (#84, #88), with light that follows the clock. A plain wall, a shelf, a cork board and a cardboard recipe box. You found it drab, and that started the redesign.
kitchens.19-magazine-collage: The redesign starts from your collage of a one-wall kitchen, drawn first as a magazine collage with cut-out edges.
kitchens.19-cookbook-plate: The same kitchen as a printed cookbook plate: flat colour, offset ink, a halftone sun. You picked this style, and it carries through to Plate XI.
kitchens.tuning-03: The tuning board settles the colours: walnut wood, sage-white wall, cobalt box, plain plaster.
kitchens.18-plate-i: Plate I, the test kitchen in the colours you tuned, with printer's marks and a palette strip.
kitchens.01-a-drawers: Layout round 1 goes back to sketches to place things. Window A carries the title; the cabinets are labelled drawers.
kitchens.01-c-openshelf: Round 1: a small window off to the side, and an open shelf under the counter for cookbooks and references.
kitchens.01-d-shorter: Round 1: an oven for the Lab notebook where the window was, over shorter cabinets.
kitchens.02-wall1-board-middle: Round 2 drops to plain blocks to decide only where things go: one board in the middle (whiteboard and cork), the box and notebook below it.
kitchens.03-equipment-lands: Round 3 tries where anniversary equipment would land: the counter ends and a pegboard.
kitchens.05-plate-border: Round 5: the very wide screen gets a plate border. By round 10 the block layout is final.
kitchens.11-kitchen-1400: Plate II draws the final block layout in the plate style: the Lab notebook, Next up on the whiteboard, ideas on the cork, a bitten eclair, cookbooks under the counter.
kitchens.12-with-eclair: Plate III calms the middle. The notebook becomes Trials, open at a spread.
kitchens.13-test-kitchen: Plate IV: a composition notebook in softer covers, more detail, mixed labels.
kitchens.13-evening: Plate IV's evening kitchen, for dark mode: the room dims and one lamp lights the counter.
kitchens.14-test-kitchen: Plate V: the composition book looks like a real one, and a torn Made this week note hangs on a cabinet.
kitchens.14-evening-board-light: Plate V evening: a light over the board instead of the lamp.
kitchens.15-test-kitchen: Plate VI turns everything to one-point perspective (one vanishing point at the board). The cork gets paler, and Recently arrives as a note on the cabinet.
kitchens.15-evening: Plate VI evening: the dark comes down from the top edge.
kitchens.16-narrower: Plate VII goes narrower: no window, no pegboard. The notebook is black marble and says TRIALS; the wall under the board grows taller.
kitchens.17-test-kitchen: Plate VIII: Recently moves up to the wall, the recipe box gets a flush lid, and the eclair is eaten in three clicks.
kitchens.17-evening-small-window: Plate VIII: Recently on a fridge, a flush lid on the recipe box, an eclair eaten in three clicks. This evening has a small dark window to compare.
kitchens.k-main: Plate IX goes wide again: a cream vintage fridge holds Recently, a window on the right, taller tile, a checkerboard floor, tape labels on the shelves.
kitchens.k-eve: Plate IX evening: the moon in the window.
kitchens.plate-x-33-2354ebf-k-wide: Plate X, signed off at v24: original green, a slim cabinet, a recipe log cabinet with RECIPE LOG on the door, a black and white floor.
kitchens.plate-xi-04-cf13a5f-mk-wide: Plate XI, the final plate kitchen, signed off: a jar of wooden spoons on a deeper sill.
kitchens.study-green-1: After the plates, your AI studies try a softer look.
kitchens.study-green-2: After the plates, your AI studies try a softer look: sage cabinets, an open cupboard, sun through a big window, the open book in the middle.
kitchens.study-green-3: Study: the desktop direction, with plants and jars along the counter.
kitchens.study-green-ari-edit: Your edit of a study, with Next up, Ideas, Trials and the shelf labels from the plates put back in.
kitchens.study-green-desktop3: Kitchen 3 from your desktop: the open cupboard and the sunny window together.
kitchens.study-h0-0: Your Kittl studies switch to a printed comic look. The counter plate, upright: mixer, recipe box with tabs, a spiral notebook.
kitchens.study-h3-0: Kittl showcase: an island with Trials, the eclair and the box, the fridge covered in notes.
kitchens.plate-xii-00-d10bf43-xa-fig-svg: Plate XII v1: Claude redraws your studies straight on. A has blue cabinets, the mixer and the box open on the counter.
kitchens.plate-xii-00-d10bf43-xb-fig-svg: v1 B: green cabinets, the island tidied. You liked neither.
kitchens.study-h1-0: New Kittl studies with a recipe board, in one point: a blue corner kitchen.
kitchens.study-h2-0: Recipe board A, straight on: the one you went on to trace.
kitchens.study-h2-1: Recipe board B: a blue corner with books above the counter.
kitchens.plate-xii-01-a9659ae-xa-fig-svg: Plate XII v2: one-point kitchens drawn from those studies, with more detail.
kitchens.plate-xii-01-a9659ae-xb-fig-svg: v2 B: the blue corner kitchen.
kitchens.study-h4-0: A vector kitchen study: blue and close.
kitchens.study-h4-1: The vector study, wide, on a checkerboard floor.
kitchens.kittl-trace: Your vector trace of recipe board A.
kitchens.plate-xii-02-b82eff6-tk-k: Plate XII v3: your trace of recipe board A, cleaned up and made clickable. You picked this direction.
kitchens.plate-xii-03-8e28fc4-tk-a-tk: v4: stem green cabinets, a cupboard that opens on a clipboard log, a small eclair and a marker.
kitchens.plate-xii-04-02efd3b-tk-a-tk: v5: the kitchen grows taller. Cupboards across the top, the open one with two shelves, the clipboard with depth.
kitchens.plate-xii-05-5fa6ccf-tk-a-tk: v6: five eclairs to choose from, notebooks stacked under the open one, a plant on the sill.
kitchens.plate-xii-06-3e4832d-tk-a-tk: v7: eclair E1, bitten, by the box. Basil, a crystal mobile and rainbows in the window; composition books in front of the whiteboard.
kitchens.plate-xii-08-61b193d-tk-a-tk: v8: a walnut window frame, and the eclair is eaten one click at a time.
kitchens.plate-xii-09-c6859d3-tk-a-tk: v9: glass study bottles on the sill, rainbows that move with the time of day, RECIPES on the box.
kitchens.plate-xii-10-ba8975e-tk-a-tk: v10: three eclairs cool on a rack, one gone per click; new bottles and journals.
